column1: # The renderer job's parts (.github/workflows/build.yml), each a process of build/test.py's
# --layout on lavapipe. A line holds a part's number, a test class or one case of a class by its
# display name, and its minutes on lavapipe held to four cores. A class goes whole into a part where
# it fits one and by its cases where it does not. There are as many parts as first fit from the
# longest needs under 38 minutes, and the classes and cases are dealt from the longest, each to the
# part holding least, so the parts come out alike. The part holding * takes every test no other
# line names, the classes that draw nothing, a class or a case added since, and the cases that skip
# themselves on a device that draws on the processor, its minutes theirs.
